tenderSchedule.description: Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Indoor LED Display Board at Kaveri, Ganga and Nala Auditoriums of Karnataka State Open University, Mysuru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of the Registrar, KSOU, Mysuru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: All terms and conditions specified in the tender document are mandatory

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have successfully executed at least one work for Supply, Installation and Commissioning of LED Display Systems with a value of not less than Rs. 15 lakhs for any Government Department, Government University or Government Organization in Karnataka and shall submit documentary evidence in the form of a Work Order along with a satisfactory Performance Certificate or Work Completion Certificate issued by the concerned authority
The bidder should have OEM Authorization certificate issued by OEM
The bidder should have ISO 9001:2015 Certificate

OEM Should have ISO 9001:2015 certificate, ISO 14001:2015 certificate, ISO 45001:2018 certificate, CE certificate, Low Voltage Directive CE (2014/35/EU) BIS certificate, FCC certificate, EPR certificate
The bidder should have minimum four service engineers with well trained by OEM.

The Bidder shall mandatorily submit a detailed Solution Plan covering the design, supply, installation, commissioning and maintenance of the LED Display Systems, including the requisite hardware, software, control systems and supporting infrastructure, as part of the bid submission. The Bidder shall also provide relevant technical specifications, product brochures, system architecture, layout diagrams of the proposed LED Display solutions, clearly indicating the features, configurations and functionalities in compliance with the stipulated Technical Specifications
The bidder must be registered by Karnataka Government Department.
Notarized Self declaration on Rs. 100/- Stamp Paper (Regarding Non-Black listing).

The bidder should not have any pending case with Central Government, State Governments or any Government organization pertaining to fraud or any other corrupt practices in India. Undertaking from the Company Secretary or the Authorized Signatory on Rs. 100/- Stamp Paper should be submitted

The bidder shall submit a duly signed Compliance Statement on the bidders official letterhead, confirming compliance with all the technical specifications and requirements stipulated in the tender document.
PAN card copy, IT returns statement, Balance sheet, and profit & loss statement of financial year 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26
Annual turnover statement certified by a CA for the financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. The average annual turnover of the firm for the last 3 Years should not be less than Rs. 300 lakhs
